_note: TEMPLATE. Copy to data/applicant_profile.json (gitignored) and edit. Used as-is when the real file is missing. Standing facts and answer policy so applications need no manual input; values here are generic placeholders.

work_authorization._rule: Eligibility follows citizenship vs the job's country; outside India => needs sponsorship.

eeo._rule: Sensitive questions are answered only from this block; 'decline' means choose a 'prefer not to say / decline to self-identify' option if one exists, otherwise skip.

consents._note: Privacy-policy/terms checkboxes are required to submit; set false to leave them for yourself.

current_city_basis: where the current role is based

answer_policy.pronouns: leave blank if optional, otherwise 'Prefer not to say'
answer_policy._note: assumed defaults; change here if you want different standing answers

legal._note: assumed; criminal-history / conviction questions are deliberately NOT prefilled
